text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report advises on the feasibility of reducing the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on West Hill Drive between Old Kingston Road and Lawrence Avenue East.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on West Hill Drive, between Old Kingston Road and Lawrence Avenue East.
